notes.title: Some Fixes and More!
notes.content:
The following fixes have been added:
[list]
[*] Support for non-QWERTY keyboards.
[*] Forums are now properly sorted.
[*] Window scaling issues have been fixed.
[*] Optimizations to help with interfacing and loading.
[/list]

notes.title: Full Revitalization
notes.content:
The Vault has been [b]completely revitalized[/b]. You can expect the following changes:
[list]
[*] You can now register your own account, using any username you wish.
[*] The help menus, assistance menus, and other menus have been completely recreated.
[*] Complete graphical overhaul.
[*] Prompts can now be updated without the application updating.
[*] Users are now able to send messages to each other; this includes verified accounts (accounts considered to be a part of other timelines, or "canon" users).
[*] More to be discovered, yet.
[/list]

Special thanks to [b]Alfuwuz[/b] for their development work on this project!

notes.title: New Logins, Better Interface
notes.content:
The following changes have been made:
[list]
[*] The number of logins has more than doubled.
[*] The text interface has been updated to be faster when searching.
[*] HELP menu has been updated.
[*] Administration functions have been modified slightly.
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for Apr 3 - Much More to Find
notes.content:
Several new things have been added, and thank you to the wonderful community members who found some spelling errors and corrections that needed to be made!

[list]
[*] Help menu has been updated.
[*] Admin mode was added.
[*] Andrew Parker's clearance level was updated for accuracy.
[*] Some typos and misspellings were corrected.
[*] 15 prompts were added.
[*] 13 prompts were updated.
[/list]

notes.title: First update, new features!
notes.content:
Thank you for an amazing launch! The community has done a great job of pointing some things out, and I've done my best to fix and rectify accordingly.

[h3]Fixes that have been made:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Typos and inaccuracies have been corrected.
[*] New logins were added appropriately.
[*] New "HELP" functions have been added.
[/list]
